4,756 likes, 72 comments - gauravmolri on September 16, 2026: "54G VEG PROTEIN IN ONE BOWL with Skin Glow Ingredients too 

FULL INGREDIENTS 
1. 200G Boiled Chickpea
2. 100G Boiled Beans 
3. 150G Paneer 
4. 2 Carrots
5. 1/2 Avocado 

RECIPE FOR GREEN GODDESS SAUCE 

1. Add yogurt+ coriander + Mint + Basils + parsley everything to a blender.
2. Blend until smooth, creamy and bright green
3. Add water & Salt little by little until you like 

FOR CHICKPEA CURRY
Marinate with mustard sauce & paprika… then cook it in a pan 
Add Gravy (Roasted & blended tomatoes & peppers for creamy texture add yogurt) 

#vegrecipe #richmeal #highprotein #paneer".

61K likes, 293 comments - gauravmolri on September 12, 2026: "Let’s get the wedding glow up together. Save this shot recipe 🤌🏻

Brother getting married  this year so i am going all in. What about you? Are you having wedding in your family? 😉

Recipe of juice here⬇️

2 beetroot 2 carrots 1 apple, just blend them 

You can ginger and lemon when you drink it. Btw yes it can be stored for until 3 days in fridge 
Rest 4 days i actually deep freeze into cubes or maybe in air tight container

Then you can use it in different ways. Best i use the cubes when i drinking water and add them into it

Super easy and manageable 🤌🏻

#juice".

20K likes, 160 comments - gauravmolri on September 9, 2026: "What you can eat for a Lean Body 😉

CHILLI SOYA CHUNKS || LENTIL SALAD || CRISPY BRINJAL || STAR FISH || CHILLI SAUCE 

GROCERY LIST 👇🏼
👉65G Soya Chunks 
👉200G Brown Lentils 
👉 250G Brinjal
👉 45G Rice 

Recipe for Chilli Soya Chunks 
👉Boil Soya for 15 Minutes in 500 ml water
👉1 Medium Tomatoes, Chillies 
👉 1 Small Onion

Once Cool enough squeeze sauce chunk and cook iy with veggies 

Lets Make Crispy Brinjal (Egg Plant) 

TO MARINATE: 
👉 Yogurt 2 Spoon 
👉 Besan 3 Spoon 
👉 Paprika 1 Spoon 

Mix well, and dip your brinjal into the marination 
Then cook it on pan until its brown both side

RECIPE FOR CHILLI SAUCE in comment 🫣

Oh just forgot the Lentil Salad, very simple 
I washed and boiled it untill its mushy and mix it with diced onion and lemon squeeze & you can add chaat masala if you want 

#highprotein #vegrecipes #lentil".
